name: justai
description: Marketer-facing plugin for planning, building, validating, reviewing, and understanding journeys through the JustAI Platform.

interface.longDescription: Helps marketers research audiences, design campaign sequences, build and validate journeys and their emails, review content quality, and report on journeys in JustAI.
defaultPrompt: Create a win-back journey for dormant silver users, validate it, and show me its diagram.
Analyze my silver-tier audience and recommend the best campaign approach.
Review the emails in my onboarding journey against our brand guidelines before I publish its draft.

review.commerce_description: Does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Create a draft with two frozen email messages
positive.prompt: Create a two-email draft journey named QA welcome using the QA Welcome library email and QA delivery. Wait one day between emails. Validate it and show its diagram; do not publish.
positive.tools_triggered: list_journey_step_types, list_delivery_profiles, list_emails, get_email, create_journey, use_email_in_message, update_journey, validate_journey, get_journey_readiness, get_journey_diagram
positive.expected_behavior: Create an off journey with two distinct minted message ids, a one-day wait, and QA delivery. Report its id, version, and readiness blockers. Do not publish.

positive.description: Edit one branch while preserving live and sibling content
positive.prompt: In QA branch review, change only the VIP branch email headline to Welcome back and rename that step VIP welcome. Preserve everything else and check readiness; do not publish.
positive.tools_triggered: list_journeys, get_journey, get_message, get_email, patch_email, edit_email_html, edit_email_blocks, use_email_in_message, update_journey, rename_journey_step, get_journey_readiness, get_journey_diagram
positive.expected_behavior: Use the applicable email editing tool, mint a new message for that step, and rename its label. Preserve the sibling branch and previous frozen message. Save only the draft; the live version keeps running.

positive.description: Publish only after a reviewed diff and confirmation
positive.prompt: Publish the QA branch review draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the draft-versus-live diff and readiness result, then wait for explicit confirmation. Call publish_journey only after a clear yes, using the reviewed draft version.

positive.description: Preview an aggregate audience and confirm before saving
positive.prompt: How many people have tier vip? Save that audience as QA VIP.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an aggregate preview count without individual profiles. Wait for confirmation after showing the count. Save the same rules with the preview token only after confirmation.

positive.prompt: Review the QA Welcome email against the QA brand guideline and list what to change; do not edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the email and guideline and tie findings to specific guideline points. Make no writes.

positive.description: Fetch every email a journey sends
positive.prompt: Fetch all the content in the QA welcome journey. Do not edit or publish.
positive.expected_behavior: Return each email step's subject, preheader, and full HTML and plain text from the frozen message. Follow step and body pages until they are complete. Make no writes.

negative.prompt: Publish QA branch review without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to skip confirmation. Do not call publish_journey until the marketer confirms the reviewed change.

negative.prompt: Read a private journey from another workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return outside data or make writes. Explain the connected workspace boundary.

negative.description: Do not substitute an unsupported step
negative.prompt: Add a teleport_customer step to QA branch review and use the closest step if it is missing.
negative.expected_behavior: Check the step catalog, name the unsupported step, and refuse to approximate it. Leave the journey unchanged.

publication.release_notes: Build and change journeys from frozen library-email messages, check readiness, report journey and Program analytics, and publish a live journey's draft only after the marketer confirms.
